name: coding-refactor-extract-error-handler
description: Refactor: extract duplicated error handling into a shared helper

turns.userMessage: Refactor `src/main.ts`: the error handling patterns in `handleRead` and `handleWrite` are duplicated. Extract them into a shared `handleIoError` helper function. Keep behavior identical.

mockResponses.text: Extracted `handleIoError(operation, path, err, rethrow?)` — a shared error handler that (1) logs the error with operation context, (2) optionally rethrows a specific error, (3) otherwise wraps in a generic `Failed to <operation> <path>` error. Both `handleRead` and `handleWrite` now delegate to it, eliminating the duplicated error handling pattern.
